remarks: CAREFREE LUXURY LIVING IN THE HEART OF STAMFORD.  Welcome to this rare, impressive, large 2,000 sq.ft. 3 bedroom 2 1/2 bath at The Buckingham: where ease, elegance, and comfort come together. Sunlight pours through oversized windows, while freshly painted interiors create a crisp, inviting backdrop for your personal style.  The open-plan living and dining room is ideal for gatherings, with sliders leading to a private balcony. The eat-in kitchen features granite counters, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar-perfect for both casual meals and entertaining.  The generous primary suite includes a walk-in closet and en-suite bath, while two additional bedrooms and a second full bath provide plenty of flexibility for guests, a home office, or hobbies. A powder room, in-unit laundry, two deeded, indoor garage spaces, and multiple storage units add everyday convenience.  At the Buckingham, you'll enjoy a 24-hour doorman, gym, pool, library, and community room, plus visitor parking and a gated garage. Just a short walk from Stamford's vibrant downtown, this home combines space, style, and low-maintenance living in one of the city's most desirable locations.
